ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, start an outing toward a town a drive away, tap "Drive there", then lock the phone (and, on another drive, switch to another app) and drive through two turns. **Expect:** each turn is spoken once as it nears; no notification of the app's own appears; nothing more is spoken after "End directions", at the town, or after Stop. Today nothing is spoken once the phone is locked: the position is read only while the app is in front (RE33).
